newsitem.title: CHINA: Angang New Steel Hong Kong IPO 99.7 pct subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Angang New Steel Hong Kong IPO 99.7 pct subscribed.

text.p: Chinese steel producer Angang New Steel Co Ltd said on Tuesday its offering of 89 million H-shares in Hong Kong was 99.7 percent subscribed.
The company said it received applications for a total of 88.75 million shares compared with 89 million shares available for public subscription in Hong Kong.
Global coordinator ING Barings has agreed to subscribe for the balance of 248,000 shares.
It said another 801 million shares for international placing were fully allotted.
Angang New Steel said the issue price of the shares had been fixed at HK$1.63 per share.
Trading in the company shares is due to begin on July 24.
The company had issued 890 million H-shares, or 40.3 percent of the enlarged share capital, at price ranging HK$1.61 to HK$1.97 each in a global flotation.
Of the total, 89 million shares offered to the public in Hong Kong and the remaining 801 million shares were placed internationally to professional and institutional investors.
H-shares are Hong Kong-listed equity in mainland China incorporated enterprises.
